Title: Parse files into extraction units
Description: As a desktop user, I want to select local files and have them automatically split into extraction units so that the AI can process them efficiently. The app normalizes text, detects headings, parses PDFs with PdfPig, DOCXs with DocumentFormat.OpenXml, and walks code trees with language-specific patterns. Large files are split by code structure or fixed token windows. The app shows a unit preview and stores units in the SQLite cache.
AcceptanceCriteria: Text normalizer removes whitespace anomalies and ensures UTF-8 encoding
Heading detector identifies section boundaries in text documents
PDF parser extracts text using PdfPig 0.1.14 (text only)
DOCX parser extracts text using DocumentFormat.OpenXml 3.5.1
Code walker splits files by function/class starts using language patterns
Code files larger than 1 MiB are skipped; NUL bytes in first 8000 bytes trigger skip
Unit preview shows page/section/file boundaries and token count
Units are stored in SQLite cache with document metadata
All code for this story lives inside Cortexa-dev/desktop/collector; nothing in services/, contracts/, frontend/ or deploy/ is edited or referenced (outside logic is re-implemented inside)
TalkingPoints: Porting the backend text normalization, heading detection, PDF/DOCX parsing, and code-splitting logic to C# desktop. Integrating PdfPig and OpenXml libraries. Splitting large code files by structure and showing unit preview in the UI. Storing units in local SQLite cache.

Tasks.Title: Port text normalizer and heading detector
Tasks.Description: Implement C# versions of text_normalizer and heading_detector from backend services/ingestion.

Tasks.Title: Implement PDF and DOCX parsers
Tasks.Description: Use PdfPig 0.1.14 for PDF text extraction and DocumentFormat.OpenXml 3.5.1 for DOCX parsing.

Tasks.Title: Build code walker with language-specific patterns
Tasks.Description: Detect function/class starts in C#/Java/JS/TS/Go/Rust/C/C++ using braces; use indentation for Python; fall back to fixed windows for large functions.

Tasks.Title: Integrate tokenizer and unit builder
Tasks.Description: Use Microsoft.ML.Tokenizers 2.0.0 to count tokens; build units with page/section/file/module boundaries.

Tasks.Title: Implement file size and content validation
Tasks.Description: Skip files >1 MiB or with NUL bytes in first 8000 bytes; ensure UTF-8 encoding.

Tasks.Title: Build unit preview screen
Tasks.Description: Display selected files, unit boundaries, token counts, and a sample of unit text in the UI.

Tasks.Title: Store units in SQLite cache
Tasks.Description: Persist units with document ID, unit kind, page/file/module metadata, and token count.

Steps.Action: Load a multi-page PDF and inspect extracted text
Steps.Expected: Text from all pages is present; page_number is recorded in unit metadata

Tests.Title: Code file is split by function boundaries

Steps.Action: Load a C# file with 3 functions and inspect units
Steps.Expected: Each function is in its own unit; unit boundaries align with function starts

Steps.Action: Create a unit with known text and check token count
Steps.Expected: Token count matches manual tokenizer run

Steps.Action: Try to load a file >1 MiB
Steps.Expected: File is skipped with clear error message

Steps.Action: Load files and inspect SQLite cache
Steps.Expected: Units table contains document_id, unit_kind, metadata, token_count
